field_mappings.transformation: Only for rows where BN_STATUS equals the documented current value Registered and BN_CANCEL_DT is blank, trim surrounding whitespace and collapse internal whitespace on the raw BN_NAME; cancelled, deregistered or otherwise non-current rows are omitted as abstentions and no historical name is presented as current.

unmapped_fields.reason: REGISTER_NAME only names the register and has no supported canonical target in the ontology subset.
BN_REG_DT gives the date the business name started; no unambiguous same-field evidence establishes entity.date_registered for the business subject, so it remains unmapped.

BN_STATUS is a generic business name registration status without supported subject evidence for entity.status; it is used only as a dependency for the current-name condition and yields no status mapping.

BN_CANCEL_DT gives a cancellation date for a business name; it does not establish whole-observation validity, and no valid_to or deregistration target is supported for this subset. It is used only as a dependency for the current-name condition.
BN_STATE_NUM is a former state number from a previous regulator; it has no supported ontology target.
BN_STATE_OF_REG is the previous state of registration of the business name, not an address of the business subject, so it is not mapped to address.state.
